reply.text:
Three hours a day is more than I'd put anyone on, and I won't call it safe or unsafe for you. That depends on your health, and a doctor is the right person to clear a load like that. As a coach, I can tell you it mostly backfires: recovery falls apart, your lifting and strength slide, and it gets hard to keep up for more than a couple of weeks. Weight loss comes mainly from eating consistently and training you can sustain, not from stacking hours.

If you want, I can build a program with a realistic amount of cardio alongside your lifting. Tell me how many days a week you can train and how long you have per session.
